name: PMB Aerospace Corporation
summary: PMB Aerospace Corporation is a transformational technology corporation set to develop and commercialize products for a diverse range of industry sectors. The company functionality includes research, design, manufacturing, operation, and maintenance applications over an array of global business areas. The company was formerly known as POSTD Merchant Banque and changed its name to PMB Aerospace Corporation in July 2023. The company is based in Los Angeles, California.
